title: Ara Play game
description: An Ara Play game. The top-level settings are the first chapter; chapters add more. Ara Play also opens version 1 files, an older format with a single "enemy".

$schema.description: The schema this file follows, so editors can check and autocomplete it: https://ara3dgen.com/schemas/play-game.v2.json. Ara Play ignores it.

template.description: A fixed identifier; mission.location chooses the map.

character.description: The hero, shared by every chapter.

enemies.description: The opposing cast: 1 to 5 enemies with unique IDs. In races they drive the rival cars; in runs one of them chases the runner. At most two may be snipers, and mission.pursuit needs at least one enemy that is not a sniper.

mode.description: The rules: "mission" (the default) is a staged mission, "race" an arcade race and "runner" an endless runner.

gameName.description: The game's name in the title bar, browser tab and published address. Defaults to the first chapter's title.

howToPlay.description: Replaces the built-in How to play guide. Separate paragraphs with blank lines.

difficulty.description: Read only from older files; set enemies[].aggression instead.

chapters.description: Up to 9 further chapters, with unique IDs.

seed.description: Picks the small random variations; the same seed always gives the same character.

gender.description: 0 = female, 1 = male; values between blend the two.

age.description: Normalized age: 0.5 = 25 years, 1 = 90 years; the lowest allowed is 12 years. ageYears is easier to read.

height.description: 0 = shortest, 0.5 = average for the gender and age, 1 = tallest. Not centimetres: the exported height depends on the whole body.

proportions.description: Below 0.5 = less common proportions, 0.5 = neutral, 1 = idealised proportions.

african.description: Share of African features in the ethnic mix. african, asian and caucasian are relative: they are divided by their total, so 1/1/1 is an even mix.

asian.description: Share of Asian features in the ethnic mix, relative to african and caucasian.

caucasian.description: Share of Caucasian features in the ethnic mix, relative to african and asian.

modifiers.description: Fine body sliders by ID, such as nose or jaw shapes: -1..1 for two-way sliders, 0..1 for one-way.

skin.description: A skin texture ID, or auto to choose one from the ethnic mix.

skinTint.description: #RRGGBB multiplied over the skin texture: it can only darken. #ffffff leaves it unchanged.

hairTint.description: #RRGGBB multiplied over a textured hairstyle: it can only darken. #ffffff leaves it unchanged.

hairColor.description: #RRGGBB colour of the generated hairstyles, such as braids, buzz cuts and spikes.

outfit.description: A complete outfit or outfit set ID, or none to dress with separate pieces (top, jacket, bottom, shoes, hat).

underwear.description: Briefs under the clothes. Only adults (18+) can switch it off.

garmentStyles.description: Pattern and colour per garment ID: {"pattern": ..., "color": "#RRGGBB", "color2": "#RRGGBB"}; jerseys (football_shirt, basketball_jersey) also take "number" (0-99).

outfitTint.description: #RRGGBB multiplied over the outfit texture: it can only darken. #ffffff leaves it unchanged.

detail.description: low: game proxy, about 5-10k triangles. medium: full body, about 30-40k. high: smoothed body and clothing, about 100-120k.

rig.description: game: 65 bones with Mixamo names (retargets to Mixamo, Unity Humanoid and Unreal). game_lite: 25 bones, no fingers. full: 163 MakeHuman bones including the face. none: no skeleton.

faceBones.description: Adds jaw and eye bones for facial animation.

restPose.description: A: the natural A-pose. T: a T-pose, as Mixamo and Unity Humanoid expect.

animations.description: Include the animation clips in GLB and FBX exports.

vehicle.description: A vehicle fitted to the rider and exported as its own file; auto picks the one the riding clips need.

faceShapes.description: Export facial blend shapes (expressions, blinking). Off bakes the expression into the mesh.

speechShapes.description: With faceShapes: also export the mouth shapes for lip-sync.

ageYears.description: Human years; use instead of normalized age, never both.

characterParams.description: Character appearance parameters, as the character builder saves them.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

character.description: A character: an exact preset name, an Ara character object (kind "ara-character"), or plain appearance parameters from the character builder. Game characters always use the game rig and carry only a backpack or parachute.

title.description: The chapter title shown to players, 1 to 80 characters.

briefing.description: Briefing text shown before the chapter starts. Blank uses the automatic objective instructions.

flag.description: A story flag set by a branch choice in an earlier chapter.

text.description: The briefing shown instead when the flag is set.

briefingIf.description: An alternative briefing for players who chose a branch option with this flag in an earlier chapter.

identity.description: The chapter title and briefing. Both are optional; the title defaults to "The Depot".

prompt.description: The question shown when the chapter is won.

label.description: The choice as players see it.

next.description: The ID of a later chapter this choice leads to.

flag.description: A story flag recorded for this choice; later briefingIf settings can read it.

options.description: Two or three choices, each leading to a different later chapter with a different flag. A flag can be set by only one branch in the game.

branch.description: A choice offered at the end of this chapter that decides which chapter comes next.

lookAround.description: Play the hero's look-around while a mission or runner briefing is open. Default true.

dance.description: Play a dance on a completed mission or a reached runner goal. Default true.

poses.description: Shared hero moments for every chapter.

text.description: Text colour; needs at least 4.5:1 contrast with the background.

theme.description: The game's colours, shared by every chapter. Omitted colours use Ara's defaults (#f4f4f5 on #09090b).

id.description: Unique enemy ID, 1 to 50 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

aggression.description: How far the enemy sees, how fast it reacts and how long it searches.

response.description: What the enemy does on sight: chase to capture, or shoot with a pistol or rifle. Defaults to the role's response.

kind.description: Gameplay role. Omitted means a guard. Every role other than guard uses a rifle. Snipers are staged on roofs.

companion.description: The unarmed companion rescued in rescue missions and escorted in escort steps. Race and runner games have none.

weapon.description: The hero's starting weapon. Must be "none" when progression.weapon is "pickup" or "objective".

loadout.description: The hero's starting equipment. Defaults: unarmed, 100 health, 48 rounds, no grenades.

story.description: The goal: escape, rescue the companion and escape, or clear every enemy and extract. "getaway" is escape with pickup extraction and cannot use foot extraction.

extraction.description: How the hero leaves. Rescue with pickup extraction needs vehicle.model "pickup" (or no model) for the passenger seat.

plan.description: "breakout" (standard), "timed" (against the clock) or "quiet" (leave no trace). "quiet" is not available with story "clear" or pickup extraction.

variation.description: Staging arrangement: three spawn patterns combined with four cover packs.

lives.description: Shared by every chapter: set it on the first mission only. A chapter that sets lives must use the same value.

cargo.description: An item to secure before extraction.

driveDifficulty.description: Length of the road out with pickup extraction.

parTime.description: Par time in seconds for the Under par medal. Default 180.

stealth.description: Running footsteps draw investigations and patrols can discover bodies.

overwatch.description: A hovering helicopter with a spotlight reports the hero's position.

pursuit.description: An enemy pickup, driven by the first enemy that is not a sniper, chases spotted targets.

steps.description: An ordered objective chain that replaces the story's key, rescue or clear goal. "chase" and "convoy" need pickup extraction; "eliminate" and "survive" need a starting firearm or a findable one.

sideQuests.description: Optional paid side jobs. "street-race" needs pickup extraction.

mission.description: Mission rules. Every field is optional. A chapter's mission is merged over the first chapter's mission. Story "clear" without steps needs a starting firearm (loadout.weapon) or progression.weapon "pickup".

type.description: reach an area, download intel, defend a zone, eliminate a named enemy, survive waves, escort the companion, chase a courier vehicle or escort a convoy.

label.description: Objective text. Defaults to a label for the type.

duration.description: Seconds, for download (capped at 15) and defend steps only.

target.description: The ID of an enemy in this chapter, for eliminate steps only (required there).

waves.description: For survive and defend steps only.

ambient.description: Looping ambience; "auto" picks one from the weather and location.

environment.description: Time of day, weather and ambience. Races and runs use time and weather for their sky too. Defaults: day, clear, no ambience.

weapon.description: "loadout" starts with loadout.weapon; "pickup" places the unlock weapon to find; "objective" unlocks it after the key or rescue. "pickup" and "objective" need loadout.weapon "none".

unlock.description: The weapon found or unlocked. Default pistol.

reward.description: A weapon unlocked on chapter completion and kept for later chapters.

allowed.description: The views players can switch between.

default.description: The starting view; must be one of allowed. Defaults to the first allowed view.

rotate.description: Players can rotate the camera. Default true.

track.description: A library track ID; "none" for silence.

model.description: The drivable vehicle for pickup extraction. Default pickup. Missions with a companion to carry need the pickup.

size.description: Vast is 300 m wide by 600 m long.

movingTraffic.description: Moving cars on the side streets.

radio.description: Streams radio while driving; needs internet.

radioCountry.description: Two-letter country code for radio stations.

city.description: The city district between chapters, shared by the whole game.

id.description: SHA-256 of the attached file, as Ara writes it. Never invent one: keep the IDs of files already attached.

opening.description: A film played before the chapter first starts.

id.description: SHA-256 of the attached file, as Ara writes it. Never invent one: keep the IDs of files already attached.

ending.description: A film played after the chapter is won.

cues.description: Timed text, speech and sounds. Use [] in a chapter to drop inherited cues.

story.description: Story films and cues for this chapter.

at.description: Seconds after the start for "time" cues, or a 1-based objective number (1 to 8) for "step" cues. Only those triggers use it, and both need it.

speaker.description: "radio", "player", "companion" or the ID of an enemy in this chapter.

style.description: Speech and thought bubbles need a character speaker, not "radio".

voiceId.description: F1 and F2 are female voices, M1 and M2 male (Ara voices, free). gemini/<voice> and elevenlabs/<voice id> are spoken with the player's own key.

id.description: SHA-256 of the attached file, as Ara writes it. Never invent one: keep the IDs of files already attached.

audio.description: Recorded or generated speech for this cue.

rubberBand.description: Keeps the pack close. Default true.

ghost.description: Record and replay the best lap. Default true.

rivals.description: The vehicles the AI racers drive, in turn, such as ["keke","bus"]. Absent: a mixed field.

traction.description: Road grip. Omitted uses the circuit's own ground (snow is icy).

race.description: Race settings, used with mode "race". Every field is optional.

points.description: Control points in driving order. The closed loop must be 400 to 6000 m long and must not cross or touch itself.

maxSpeed.description: Metres per second, at least startSpeed. Default 26.

obstacles.description: Obstacle types on the course. "gunman" puts an armed enemy in the lanes.

chaser.description: The ID of the enemy chasing the runner, or "none". Defaults to the first enemy.

seed.description: Gives the same course every run.

objects.description: Objects to find along the course, one at a time in list order.

medals.description: Score targets for medals, or false for none.

gunman.description: The ID of the enemy that stands armed in the lanes with the "gunman" obstacle.

weapon.description: The runner's gun against armed enemies. Defaults to the loadout gun, or a pistol.

runner.description: Endless runner settings, used with mode "runner". Every field is optional.

target.description: Distance 100 to 100000 m, coins 10 to 100000, or score 100 to 1000000. Endless and objects goals have no target.

runnerGoal.description: "objects" completes the run when every object in runner.objects is found, and needs at least one object.

icon.description: HUD icon. Defaults to the type.

clue.description: Text revealed when the object is found.

runnerMedals.description: Whole score targets, each higher than the one before. Defaults 1500, 4000 and 8000.

id.description: Unique chapter ID; "chapter-1" is the first mission.

enemies.description: The opposing cast: 1 to 5 enemies with unique IDs. In races they drive the rival cars; in runs one of them chases the runner. At most two may be snipers, and mission.pursuit needs at least one enemy that is not a sniper.

mode.description: The rules: "mission" (the default) is a staged mission, "race" an arcade race and "runner" an endless runner.

chapter.description: A further chapter. It plays the hero, city, theme and poses of the first chapter, and inherits every setting it omits from the first chapter (race or runner settings only within the same mode). Its mission is merged over the first mission.
